experience.player_does: Launch the game, press Play, and see the authored map fill the entire borderless display while keeping the selected 15-unit cell presentation.
experience.feels_like: The game opens as a seamless fullscreen surface rather than a decorated window, and the map reaches every edge of the fixed logical view without background margins.
experience.camera: Keep the fixed 1920x1080 logical viewport and current top-left map presentation; fullscreen changes the window surface, not the camera or cell geometry.
experience.controls: Existing Play and Quit behavior remains unchanged. No new fullscreen toggle or map-editing control is added in this slice.
experience.not_this: Not a resolution-dependent redraw, stretched cell geometry, camera zoom, streaming system, or map editor.

design_refs.why: The settled presentation keeps a consistent logical view while the authored surface must provide enough world context to occupy it.
The map grows around the permanent cell pitch without changing the existing cell grammar or persisted token format.
The expanded authored map remains versioned, strict, data-only content consumed by the existing validator.

considered_existing.why_not: It already owns the logical viewport, runtime window setup, cell pitch, and map rendering, so extending it avoids a second presentation path.
It is the existing end-to-end authored map and can be expanded in its current compressed row-token format without inventing a new content format.
Its authored-map test already verifies the real map dimensions and landmarks, so the expected coverage belongs there rather than in a new fixture.
It is engine-owned in this repository; runtime window configuration belongs in the existing main presentation node.

modules.role: Own the fixed logical presentation and configure the running window as borderless fullscreen.
modules.why: The 4K surface should use the existing logical canvas and permanent cell pitch without introducing a second renderer or resolution-specific layout.
modules.boundary_data: Reads typed LevelFormat and LevelLayer values and emits the existing canvas presentation; window mode is local presentation state.

modules.role: Verify the expanded authored map still loads with the expected logical-frame coverage.
modules.why: The map dimensions are part of the visible outcome and should remain checked at the content boundary.
modules.boundary_data: Loads typed LevelFormat values and observes dimensions and landmark cell values.

files.why: Configure the existing window as borderless fullscreen while preserving the fixed logical viewport and 15-unit cell pitch.
Expand the authored map to cover the full logical frame at the permanent cell pitch, retaining the existing map content and format.
Update the real authored-map coverage assertion to the expanded dimensions.
Record the borderless fullscreen surface and full-frame authored coverage as the current presentation direction.
Append the human-settled fullscreen and map-coverage decision without rewriting earlier decisions.
Regenerate the design index after the scale-and-camera section changes.

functions.why: Set the existing game window to borderless fullscreen without changing the fixed logical content scale.
